notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Reforge the Soul from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {3}{R}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand, then causing you to draw seven cards, then create seven Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
